We establish convergence guarantees for general non-convex objectives and show that DMFL-SQ achieves an $\mathcal{O}(T^{-1/2})$ rate in expected squared Moreau-envelope stationarity despite sparse, quantized, and event-triggered communication. We further derive PAC-Bayes generalization guarantees for the fairness-aware mixture objective. Experiments on CIFAR-10 and the real heterogeneous MUSMET EEG dataset demonstrate that DMFL-SQ substantially reduces communication while maintaining predictive performance and improving fairness across clients. Together, our theoretical and empirical results show that personalization, fairness, and communication efficiency can be jointly achieved in decentralized learning while preserving the dominant convergence rate.

</details>


### [266] [A Single Suffix to Break Them All: Basin-Aware Jailbreaks for Merged Model Families](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26506)
*Yu Zhe,Yixin Tan,Junhao Wei,Wang Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文发现模型合并（Model Merging）存在一种此前被忽视的越狱风险，该风险源于预训练基础模型本身，即使所有组成模型都经过安全对齐。作者提出Basin-Aware Jailbreak (BAJ)方法，将越狱后缀生成建模为合并空间上的min-max优化问题，可生成在共享同一预训练骨架的合并模型家族间具有高迁移性的对抗性后缀，且对现有防御有效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究主要将模型合并的安全风险归因于不安全的组成模型，隐含假设合并多个安全对齐的模型会保持安全性。作者发现这一假设是错误的——即使所有组成模型都经过安全对齐，模型合并仍可能暴露源自预训练基础模型的越狱风险，因此需要新的威胁模型和攻击方法。

Method: 提出BAJ (Basin-Aware Jailbreak)方法，将越狱对抗后缀的生成形式化为合并空间上的min-max优化问题。攻击者无需访问确切的合并系数或组成检查点，仅需知道共享的预训练骨架，即可构造在合并模型家族上具有泛化能力的越狱提示。

Result: 在多种不同的基础模型骨架和合并设置下，BAJ实现了持续高迁移成功率，并且对现有防御方法仍保持有效性。

Conclusion: 模型合并即使由安全对齐的组成模型构成，也可能暴露基础模型的潜在安全弱点。所提BAJ方法揭示了这一新的攻击面，并提供了高效的迁移性越狱攻击手段，表明需要重新审视模型合并情境下的安全评估。

Abstract: Model merging enables combining multiple fine-tuned models without additional training, but its safety implications remain poorly understood. Prior work primarily attributes merging risks to unsafe constituent models, implicitly assuming that merging individually aligned models preserves safety. In contrast, we show that model merging reveals a previously overlooked jailbreak risk rooted in the pretrained foundation model, even when all constituent models are individually safety-aligned. Motivated by this observation, we study a new threat setting where an attacker constructs jailbreak prompts that generalize across merged models sharing the same pretrained backbone, without access to the exact merging coefficients or constituent checkpoints. To exploit this phenomenon, we propose \textbf{Basin-Aware Jailbreak (BAJ)}, which formulates jailbreak generation as a min--max optimization over the merging space to produce transferable adversarial suffixes across merged model families. Experiments across diverse backbones and merging settings show that BAJ achieves consistently high transfer success rates and remains effective under existing defenses.

</details>


### [267] [Algorithmic Principles For Multiclass Learning Are Hard To Come By: Limits of Regularization and Proper Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26516)
*Julian Asilis,Shaddin Dughmi,Vatsal Sharan,Alec Sun,Shang-Hua Teng,Chang Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究统计学习理论中的三个核心开放问题，证明多类学习不能通过扩充假设类规约为proper learning，proper learning可能需要在训练集上产生误差且该现象有精确刻画，以及正则化（包括SRM和局部正则化器）并非普适的学习器。同时给出SRM可学习性的两个充分条件，并通过"揭示偏好可积性"刻画SRM可表示性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 统计学习理论中"什么问题可学习"已有组合维数等优雅答案，但"应如何学习"这一问题长期悬而未决：所有已知的通用多类学习器依赖于指数大小one-inclusion结构的复杂定向，而proper learning和正则化等经典算法原理仍未被充分理解。作者受先前工作启发，追问学习是否能归结为proper learning（可能在更大假设类上），以及proper/improper多类学习是否能最终由合适的正则化器捕获。

Method: 作者通过构造反例回答三个开放问题：构造一个可学习但无法嵌入任何properly learnable类的多类学习问题；建立proper learning训练误差的精确刻画——证明每个properly learnable类都存在在规模m样本上仅犯o(m)次错误的proper learner，但任意预设的次线性尺度a_m=o(m)都是某个properly learnable问题所必需的；构造无法被任何SRM学习器学习的properly learnable类，以及无法被任何局部正则化器学习的可学习类。此外，给出SRM可学习性的两个充分条件，并通过揭示偏好的可积性刻画SRM可表示性。

Result: 三个开放性问题的否定答案：学习不能通过扩大假设类归结为proper learning；proper learning的训练误差具有精确的次线性尺度刻画；正则化（SRM和局部正则化器）不是普适的学习机制。同时建立SRM可学习性的正面充分条件理论及SRM可表示性的积性刻画。

Conclusion: 本文从根本上否定了"学习可归结为proper learning"和"正则化是普适学习原理"这两个假设，揭示了proper learning误差的本质特征，并为SRM可表示性提供了新的理论框架。这些结果深化了对多类学习算法原理的理解，阐明了算法设计空间的基本边界。

Abstract: Two of the most fundamental questions in statistical learning theory are the following: which prediction problems are learnable, and how should they be learned? For the former, elegant answers often take the form of combinatorial dimensions. The latter question, however, has proved considerably more elusive: all known general-purpose multiclass learners rely on intricate orientations of exponentially large one-inclusion structures, and familiar algorithmic principles such as proper learning and regularization remain poorly understood. Motivated by prior work, we ask whether learning reduces to proper learning---possibly over a larger hypothesis class---and whether proper or improper multiclass learning can ultimately be captured by suitable regularizers.
  Our primary results answer both questions negatively, resolving three open problems from prior work. First, we exhibit a learnable multiclass problem that cannot be embedded in any properly learnable class, meaning learning cannot be reduced to proper learning by enlarging the hypothesis class. Second, we demonstrate that proper learning can require training error and characterize this phenomenon precisely: every properly learnable class admits a proper learner making $o(m)$ errors on samples of size $m$, but every prescribed sublinear scale $a_m=o(m)$ is necessary for some properly learnable problem. Third, regularization is not a general learner: we exhibit a properly learnable class that cannot be learned by any Structural Risk Minimization (SRM) learner, and a learnable class that cannot be learned by any local regularizer. We complement these impossibility results with a positive theory that gives two sufficient conditions for SRM learnability and characterizes SRM representability through integrability of revealed preferences.

</details>


### [268] [High Probability Derivative Bounds for Random tanh Neural Networks on a Hypercube](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26526)
*Josef Dick,Michael Feischl,Fabian Zehetgruber*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文为宽随机神经网络的高阶混合输入导数建立了高概率界，特别针对tanh激活函数与Xavier初始化的网络。通过隔离最高阶导数中的线性项并借助可测有限网控制切线方向，显著改善了确定性分析中随深度指数增长的导数界，得到一阶导数与深度无关、高阶导数随深度多项式增长的估计，并由此推出网络实现的有界性及在QMC积分和训练分析中的应用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 确定性分析基于权重矩阵的欧几里得算子范数，得到的导数界通常随网络深度指数增长，这过于保守且不能反映宽网络的真实正则性行为。作者希望建立更精确的高概率导数界，以理解深度神经网络（尤其是tanh网络）的底层正则性结构，从而为网络泛化分析、函数逼近及基于QMC的训练方法提供理论支撑。

Method: 作者假定激活函数的导数满足阶乘增长条件，对宽度足够大的随机网络建立混合输入导数的高概率界。核心技术在于将最高阶导数中关于权重梯度方向上的线性项分离出来，并使用可测有限网（measurable finite nets）来控制相应的切方向，从而避免直接依赖欧几里得算子范数导致的指数增长。对tanh网络在Gaussian权重与Xavier初始化下给出具体常数与宽度条件，并导出Lipschitz常数与加权Sobolev范数的高概率界。

Result: 在宽度满足n≥C(L³n₀²(1+logn₀)+L²(1+log(L/η)))的条件下，以至少1-η的概率，对任意非空指标集u和任意x∈[0,1]^{n₀}成立|D^u R_{Φ^(L)}(x)|≤C₀|u|!(C₁L)^{|u|-1}∏_{j∈u}β_j(η,n₀)。一阶导数界与深度无关；m阶（无平方混合）导数至多按L^{m-1}多项式增长（忽略坐标因子）。由此得到Euclidean Lipschitz常数与加权Sobolev范数的高概率界，后者将导数估计与QMC积分和QMC训练分析联系起来。

Conclusion: 本文定量刻画了宽tanh网络的导数正则性：在足够宽的条件下，导数界随深度仅呈多项式而非指数增长，这一改善的理论价值在于为深度网络提供了Farfield正则性保证，并揭示了网络实现的光滑性与QMC积分收敛率之间的深层联系，为基于QMC的训练方法的误差分析提供了新途径。

Abstract: We establish high-probability bounds for mixed input derivatives of wide random neural networks whose activation derivatives satisfy a factorial growth bound. Our main result specializes these estimates to $\tanh$ networks with Xavier initialization. A direct deterministic analysis based on Euclidean operator norms of the weight matrices yields derivative bounds that generally grow exponentially with the depth. We show that this growth can be substantially improved for sufficiently wide Gaussian networks by isolating the term that is linear in the highest-order derivative and controlling the corresponding tangent directions by measurable finite nets.
  For scalar-output $\tanh$ networks with Gaussian weights and Xavier initialization, we prove that there exist constants $C,C_0,C_1>0$ such that, whenever the common hidden width satisfies $n \geq C\left(L^3n_0^2(1+\log n_0)+L^2\left(1+\log(L/η)\right)\right)$, then, with probability at least $1-η$, the estimate $\left|D^u\mathcal{R}_{Φ^{(L)}}(x)\right| \leq C_0 |u|! (C_1L)^{|u|-1}\prod_{j\in u}β_j(η,n_0)$ holds simultaneously for every non-empty $u\subseteq[n_0]$ and every $x\in[0,1]^{n_0}$. Thus, the first-order derivative bound is independent of the depth, while a square-free mixed derivative of order $|u|$ grows at most polynomially as $L^{|u|-1}$, apart from the coordinate factors. As consequences, we obtain high-probability bounds for the Euclidean Lipschitz constant and for weighted Sobolev norms of the network realization. The latter connect the derivative estimates to quasi-Monte Carlo integration and indicate how such regularity can enter the analysis of QMC-based training.

</details>


### [269] [Predicting Quantifiability from Primary Screens to Prioritize Dose-Response Profiling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26538)
*Sean Lim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种将"定量可行性"（quantifiability）——即后续剂量-响应测试能否产生可用的效价估计——作为独立于生物活性之外的候选化合物分选目标的建模框架。研究发现定量可行性可以由前期低成本筛选结果强预测，且预测信息主要来自筛选特征而非分子结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高通量药物筛选依靠低成本初级实验来优先筛选化合物进行更昂贵的剂量-响应分析，但当前策略仅关注确认生物活性，隐含假设确认活性必然能产生可用的效价估计。然而实际上，活性化合物在后续检测中仍可能无法产出可报告的剂量-响应数据。因此需要将"定量可行性"作为独立的分选目标来建模，以优化昂贵的剂量-响应分析资源的分配。

Method: 构建了定量可行性预测框架：（1）将定量可行性（后续检测能否产生可用效价估计）作为与生物活性相区别的独立分选目标；（2）利用前期低成本筛选的特征来预测定量可行性；（3）比较筛选特征与分子结构在预测中的信息贡献；（4）在未见过的化学骨架和held-out的assay机制家族上验证预测鲁棒性。

Result: 定量可行性可从前期低成本筛选中强预测；大部分预测信息来自观察到的筛选特征而非分子结构；基于响应的预测因子在未见的化学骨架和跨assay机制家族上保持稳健；成功定量的概率随响应幅度和实验环境显著变化。

Conclusion: 实验可测量性（不同于生物活性）可作为筛选结果的一个可预测属性，定量可行性感知的分选策略能够改善昂贵的剂量-响应分析能力的分配。

Abstract: High-throughput drug screening relies on low-cost primary assays to prioritize compounds for more expensive dose-response profiling, where potency is ultimately quantified. Current screening strategies largely focus on identifying compounds that will confirm biological activity on follow-up, implicitly assuming that confirmed activity will also yield a usable potency estimate. However, confirmed biological activity in screening does not necessarily translate into a quantifiable potency, because active compounds can still fail to produce a reportable dose-response estimate. We therefore present a framework for modeling quantifiability, whether follow-up testing will yield a usable potency estimate, as a distinct triage objective from biological activity. Quantifiability was strongly predictable from the preceding low-cost screen, with most predictive information arising from the observed screening features rather than molecular structure. Response-based predictors remained robust on previously unseen chemical scaffolds and generalized across held-out assay-mechanism families, while the probability of successful quantification varied strongly with response amplitude and assay context. These findings establish experimental measurability, distinct from biological activity, as a predictable property of screening outcomes and show that quantifiability-aware triage can improve the allocation of costly dose-response profiling capacity.

</details>


### [270] [Chart2SVG: Editable SVG Generation from Raster Chart Images](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26544)
*Jinning Cui,Lu Chen,Haoyan Shi,Yue He,Chenglong Wang,Mengyu Zhou,Weidong Huang,Yunhai Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Chart2SVG，一个多模态大语言模型，将静态栅格图表转换为结构组织良好、语义丰富的SVG，支持程序化编辑。通过引入图表专用语义token和Beagle+数据集（33K规范化的图表样本），结合专门训练目标和渲染感知后训练，模型输出的SVG兼具视觉准确性和结构一致性。同时构建Chart Structure Graph (CSG)以支持更高级的交互操作。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 静态栅格图表无法支持程序化编辑、交互式探索和布局复用等高级操作，且现有方法在图表结构恢复和语义理解方面表现不足，难以实现从栅格图到可编辑矢量图形的自动转换。

Method: 1) 在多模态大语言模型中引入图表专用的语义token，捕获几何图元及其功能角色；2) 构建Beagle+数据集，包含33K经过规范化和结构蒸馏处理的图表样本；3) 采用专门训练目标与渲染感知后训练相结合的方法，保证SVG输出的视觉准确性和结构一致性；4) 构建Chart Structure Graph (CSG)来暴露视觉依赖关系，支持更高级别的操作。

Result: 实验表明Chart2SVG在重建保真度和下游编辑实用性方面显著优于基线方法，为智能交互式可视化工具的发展提供了有力支撑。

Conclusion: 通过语义感知的结构重组技术，Chart2SVG成功实现了从静态栅格图到可编辑SVG的转换，推动了智能化和交互式可视化工具的进步，验证了融合图表语义token和结构图建模的有效性。

Abstract: We present Chart2SVG, a multimodal large language model that converts static raster charts into structurally organized, semantically enriched SVGs that support programmatic editing. By incorporating chart-specific semantic tokens into a vision-language model, Chart2SVG captures both geometric primitives and their functional roles. To support robust structural recovery, we introduce Beagle+, a dataset of 33K canonicalized and structurally distilled chart samples. Our approach combines specialized training objectives with a rendering-aware post-training phase, producing SVGs that are both visually accurate and structurally consistent. To facilitate higher-level manipulations, we construct a Chart Structure Graph (CSG) that exposes visual dependencies, enabling tasks such as interactive exploration, chart repurposing, and layout reuse. Experiments show that Chart2SVG substantially outperforms baselines in reconstruction fidelity and downstream editing utility, advancing the development of intelligent and interactive visualization tools.

</details>


### [271] [Arrive and Survive: Scaling Safe Goal-Conditioned Policy Learning from One-Bit Failure Signals](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26571)
*Guopeng Li,Yiyang Duan,Yiru Jiao,Chengcheng Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了Safe-CRL方法，在失败终止的马尔可夫决策过程中修正对比强化学习（CRL）的目标达成值估计偏差，通过质量加权InfoNCE和对数生存质量分数两个最小修正，实现安全的目标条件强化学习。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的对比强化学习（CRL）在构建正样本时只考虑失败前的未来目标，忽略了失败终止所去除的概率质量。理论分析表明这一疏漏会导致目标达成值的系统性高估偏差，使得接近失败的轨迹提供过强的成功监督信号，强化不安全行为，导致策略学习失败和不可持续的目标达成行为。

Method: 提出两个最小但有效的修正：(1) 质量加权InfoNCE（mass-weighted InfoNCE）修正Critic学习中短存活未来的过度加权问题；(2) 对数生存质量分数（log-survival-mass score）恢复策略优化中缺失的生存质量。整个方法只需失败终止的一位二进制信号。

Result: 在十二个易失败的机器人导航和运动任务中，Safe-CRL持续改善存活率，并在目标达成性能上显著优于Scaling-CRL基线。深层Safe-CRL策略还展现出复杂的避障行为。

Conclusion: 本研究完整了失败终止条件下的CRL理论，并提供了一个可扩展的安全强化学习框架，代码已开源。

Abstract: Contrastive reinforcement learning (CRL) scales effectively in goal-conditioned tasks by casting policy learning into a self-supervised contrastive objective. However, in a failure-terminated Markov decision process, established CRL considers pre-failure future goals only when constructing positive samples, without accounting for the probability mass removed by failure termination. Our theoretical analysis shows that this omission induces a systematic overestimation bias in goal-reaching values. Consequently, near-failure trajectories provide disproportionately strong supervision of success despite retaining little future occupancy. Unsafe actions can thereby be reinforced through catastrophic failure bootstrapping, leading to failed policy learning and unsustainable goal-reaching behaviours. To address this problem, we introduce two minimal yet strong corrections: mass-weighted InfoNCE corrects the overweighting of short surviving futures in critic learning, and a log-survival-mass score restores the missing survival mass in policy optimization. The resulting method, Safe Contrastive Reinforcement Learning (Safe-CRL), requires only the one-bit signal provided by failure termination to scale safe goal-conditioned policy learning. Across twelve failure-prone robot navigation and locomotion tasks, Safe-CRL consistently improves survival and substantially outperforms the Scaling-CRL baseline in goal-reaching performance. Additionally, deep Safe-CRL policies exhibit complex failure-avoidance behaviours. This study completes the CRL theory under failure termination and provides a scalable safe RL framework. The code is available via https://github.com/RomainLITUD/safe-crl.

</details>


### [272] [Activation Outliers Matter: Robust Recovery for Quantized Multimodal LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26581)
*Tanzila Rahman,Mehran Taghian Jazi,Yunke Peng,Zhuang Ma,Anandharaju Durai Raju,Yao Wang,Xing Huang,Hei Yi Mak,Shadan Golestan,Hoang Le,Yonghan Dong,Wei Guo,Yaoyuan Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了多模态大语言模型（MLLM）中的低比特量化方案，发现激活量化是4比特量化性能损失的主要来源，并提出了残差回退量化（RFQ）框架，通过辅助量化残差通路来补偿激活量化误差，在MXFP4和HiF4等超低比特格式下显著恢复模型性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低比特量化是降低MLLM计算和内存需求的有效途径，但激进的4比特量化会导致显著的性能退化。理解和定位性能损失的根本原因是设计更优量化方案的前提。

Method: 首先对MXFP8、MXFP4和HiF4等量化方案在视频生成和推理任务的MLLM上进行系统性消融研究，定位激活量化为主要性能瓶颈。基于此观察，提出RFQ（Residual Fallback Quantization）框架：在超低比特激活表示基础上，增加一条辅助量化残差通路来显式建模并补偿量化误差，无需架构修改且计算开销可忽略。

Result: 在Wan2.2和Qwen3-VL上的实验表明，MXFP8接近无损性能，而RFQ能持续恢复MXFP4和HiF4量化下丢失的大部分性能，显著缩小与BF16基线的差距，覆盖生成和推理两类基准。

Conclusion: 确立了激活量化是超低比特MLLM的主导性能瓶颈，并证明基于残差的激活重建是稳健的4比特部署的有效实用策略。

Abstract: Low-bit quantization offers a promising avenue for reducing the computational and memory demands of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). Recent hardware support for low-precision formats, ranging from MXFP8 to ultra-low-bit formats such as MXFP4 and HiF4, has accelerated research into efficient MLLM training and deployment. In this work, we present a systematic study of these quantization schemes in representative MLLMs that span both video generation and reasoning tasks. Our analysis shows that MXFP8 achieves near-lossless performance, whereas aggressive 4-bit quantization leads to significant degradation. Through extensive ablations, we identify activation quantization as the primary source of this performance loss, contributing substantially more than weight quantization. Motivated by this observation, we propose Residual Fallback Quantization (RFQ), a lightweight activation reconstruction framework that supplements the primary ulta-low-bit activation representation with an auxiliary quantized residual pathway. By explicitly modeling and compensating for quantization errors, RFQ improves activation fidelity while preserving the efficiency advantages of ultra-low-bit computation. RFQ requires no architectural modifications and incurs negligible computational overhead. Extensive experiments on Wan2.2 and Qwen3-VL demonstrate that RFQ consistently recovers a substantial portion of the performance lost under the quantization of MXFP4 and HiF4, significantly narrowing the gap to BF16 baselines across both generation and 4 reasoning benchmarks. Our findings establish activation quantization as the dominant bottleneck in ultra-low-bit MLLMs and highlight residual-based activation reconstruction as an effective and practical strategy for robust 4-bit deployment.

</details>


### [273] [J-Zero: Unified Challenger--Solver--Judge Co-Evolution from Zero Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26582)
*Gyouk Chu,Myeongho Jeon,Eunho Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: J-Zero是一个统一的Challenger-Solver-Judge共演化框架，支持在可验证和不可验证领域中实现语言模型的自我进化，通过对抗性交互生成更难的任务和更高质量的响应，并在十次迭代中持续超越基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自我进化语言模型是迈向超级智能的有前景路径，可降低人工监督成本。然而，现有研究主要集中在可验证领域，在不可验证领域的自我进化探索不足，需要一种能够同时支持两个领域的统一框架。

Method: 提出J-Zero框架，包含三个核心组件：挑战者(Challenger)生成难度递增的任务，求解者(Solver)学习产生更高质量的响应，两者通过对抗性交互共演化。同时，评判者(Judge)使用预先知道排序的偏好对进行共适应，这些偏好对的顺序由响应的产生方式决定（即Solver的答案优于Challenger的，分解重组后的答案优于一次性答案），而非依赖Judge自身的评分。

Result: J-Zero在可验证领域平均超过基线4.2分，在不可验证领域平均超过基线8.0分，并且至少持续改进十次迭代，而基线在两次迭代后性能下降。

Conclusion: J-Zero通过统一的Challenger-Solver-Judge共演化框架，有效解决了不可验证领域自我进化的难题，并在两个领域都实现了持续、稳定的性能提升，显著优于现有基线方法。

Abstract: Self-evolving language models have recently emerged as a promising path toward superintelligence, with the advantage of reducing the cost of human supervision. While considerable progress has been made in verifiable domains, self-evolution in unverifiable domains remains substantially less explored. We propose Judge co-adaptation from Zero data (J-Zero), a unified Challenger--Solver--Judge co-evolution framework that supports self-improvement across both domains. The Challenger and Solver co-evolve through an adversarial interaction: the Challenger generates increasingly difficult tasks, while the Solver learns to produce higher-quality responses to them. In parallel, the Judge co-adapts using preference pairs whose ordering is known in advance from how each response was produced, i.e., the Solver's answer over the Challenger's, and its decomposed-and-recombined answer over its one-shot answer, rather than from the Judge's own scores. J-Zero outperforms the baselines by an average of 4.2 points on verifiable and 8.0 points on unverifiable domains, and continues to improve through at least ten iterations, whereas the baselines degrade after two.

</details>


### [274] [GRAS: Guided Reduced-Variance Proposals and Adaptive Selection for Training-Free Reward Alignment in Discrete Diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26585)
*Kwanyoung Kim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出GRAS方法，通过Rao-Blackwell化估计降低引导方差、使用组相对优势自适应调整重采样温度，在无需训练的离散扩散模型推理时引导中同时超越既往训练无关方法并匹敌或超过奖励微调模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离散扩散模型在序列生成中应用广泛，但推理时无需重训练地向特定奖励引导日益重要。现有的训练无关引导通常结合梯度引导与搜索，但存在两个缺陷：引导提议从单一噪声样本估计梯度导致方差大；搜索以固定温度重采样粒子，忽略了奖励在每个去噪步骤中的分布情况。

Method: 提出GRAS，包含两组改动（不增加去噪器计算成本）：1) 对可微奖励采用Rao-Blackwell化减少梯度估计方差；对不可微奖励采用留一法基线。2) 将每步值标准化为组相对优势，并证明其可退化为单一核心成分——自适应重采样温度。

Result: 在调控DNA和蛋白质设计任务上，GRAS达到最优的训练无关奖励，优于既往训练无关方法，并匹配或超过奖励微调模型；对不可微奖励同样保持有效。

Conclusion: GRAS简单且有效：以零额外去噪成本修正了引导提议方差和固定重采样温度两大弱点，在多种任务和奖励类型下均展现卓越性能。

Abstract: Discrete diffusion models have become a strong, widely adopted class of generators for sequence data, and steering them toward a downstream reward at inference time, without any retraining, is increasingly important. Such training-free steering is done by gradient guidance, by search, or by combining the two. We study the combined regime and identify two weaknesses in how it is usually run: the guided proposal estimates its gradient from a single noisy sample, and the search then resamples particles at a fixed temperature that ignores how rewards spread across each denoising step. We address both with a small set of changes that add no denoiser cost. For the proposal, we lower the estimator variance with a Rao-Blackwellized reveal for differentiable rewards and a leave-one-out baseline for non-differentiable ones; for the search, we standardize the per-step values into a group-relative advantage and prove it collapses to a single active ingredient, an adaptive resampling temperature. We call the resulting method Guided Reduced-variance proposals and Adaptive Selection (GRAS). GRAS is simple yet effective: across regulatory DNA and protein design it attains the best training-free reward, outperforming prior training-free methods and matching or surpassing a reward-fine-tuned model, and it remains effective even for non-differentiable rewards.

</details>


### [275] [SimCast-S2S: An Efficient Generative Model for Subseasonal Precipitation Forecasting via Transfer Learning from Climate Simulations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26594)
*Hiep V. Dang,Antonios Mamalakis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SimCast-S2S 是一个基于潜空间扩散模型的生成式框架，用于次季节到季节（S2S）尺度降水的概率预报，通过变分自编码器在潜空间生成大规模集合预报，并利用 LoRA 从气候模拟预训练迁移到再分析数据微调，在多项指标上优于深度学习基线，并在许多情况下与 ECMWF-S2S 等运营系统竞争甚至超越。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: S2S 降水预报具有重要的金融和社会影响，但存在预测信号弱、不确定性高、运营系统计算成本高三大瓶颈，需要一种数据驱动且能进行概率预报的高效方法。

Method: 采用生成式潜扩散框架：1）利用基于扩散的生成管道实现概率 S2S 预报，有效从条件分布采样；2）通过变分自编码器（VAE）在紧凑潜空间中操作，实现大规模集合的高效生成；3）利用 LoRA 低秩适应进行迁移学习，先在气候模拟大集合上预训练，再在有限的再分析数据上微调。

Result: 在再分析数据上，SimCast-S2S 优于 CNN 和 U-Net 等深度学习基线；尽管仅使用部分大气输入变量且无后处理、偏差校正或校准，仍在多数情况下与 ECMWF-S2S 等先进运营系统相当甚至更优。

Conclusion: 潜空间生成建模结合模拟到再分析的迁移学习，为数据驱动的概率 S2S 降水预报提供了一条高效且可扩展的路径。

Abstract: Subseasonal-to-seasonal (S2S) precipitation forecasting has substantial financial and societal impact, yet remains challenging because of weak predictive signals, high associated uncertainty, and the computational cost of operational systems, which constrains simulation fidelity. We introduce SimCast-S2S, a generative latent-diffusion framework for probabilistic S2S precipitation forecasting that addresses three major bottlenecks in data-driven prediction. First, because S2S prediction requires uncertainty quantification rather than only deterministic point forecasts, SimCast-S2S is the first data-driven system that uses a diffusion-based generative pipeline for S2S prediction, enabling effective sampling from the underlying conditional distribution. Second, since generating large probabilistic ensembles is computationally costly in physical space, SimCast-S2S instead operates in a compact latent space learned by variational autoencoders, enabling efficient large-ensemble generation. Third, diffusion models typically require large training datasets; SimCast-S2S overcomes this via transfer learning with low-rank adaptation (LoRA), pretraining on large ensembles of climate simulations before fine-tuning on limited reanalysis data. On reanalysis data, SimCast-S2S outperforms deep learning baselines, including convolutional neural networks and U-Net architectures. Notably, despite using only a subset of atmospheric input variables and no post-processing, bias correction, or calibration, SimCast-S2S remains competitive with, and in many cases outperforms, state-of-the-art operational systems such as the ECMWF-S2S baseline. These results indicate that latent generative modeling combined with simulation-to-reanalysis transfer learning offers an efficient and scalable path toward data-driven probabilistic S2S precipitation forecasting.

</details>


### [276] [Technical Comparative Benchmarking Study: Advanced AI Hybrid Methods for Renewable Energy Farm Optimization and Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26613)
*Majid Masoumi,Asghar Dashtiy,Mohammad Dehghan,Mina Rajabi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究在互补的可再生能源场景下，对传统机器学习、集成学习、深度神经网络、循环架构、Transformer、图模型及混合集成深度学习进行了全面基准测试。Extra Trees在处理结构化WEC数据时表现最佳（较MLP基线MAE降低63.7%）；STGCN通过学习空间和时序交互获得MAE=167.0 kW、R=0.93；RF BiLSTM混合模型取得最佳整体预测精度（MAE=150.5 kW，较LSTM降低约75%）。实验表明没有单一AI架构普遍最优，不同类型架构适用于不同数据特征场景。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可再生能源预测领域缺乏对各种AI架构（从传统机器学习到图网络、混合集成学习）在互补场景下的系统性对比研究，需要明确不同数据结构和特征下何种模型更优，为实际工程选型提供依据。

Method: 使用了三个数据集：大规模WEC数据集、16 WEC数据集、以及Penmanshiel风电场的10分钟SCADA运维数据。在统一框架下对比了传统ML、集成学习（如Extra Trees、RF）、深度神经网络、循环神经网络、Transformer、图卷积网络（STGCN）以及混合集成深度学习方法（RF BiLSTM），评估各模型在不同数据结构和特征下的预测性能。

Result: Extra Trees在结构化WEC布局数据上最强，较MLP基线MAE降低约63.7%；STGCN通过显式学习空间-时序交互将MAE降至约167.0 kW并达R=0.93；RF BiLSTM混合模型取得最佳整体精度（MAE=150.5 kW），较独立LSTM降低约75%，较STGCN提升约10%。

Conclusion: 不存在普遍最优的AI架构：随机化和提升集成对结构化WEC代理建模尤为有效，图网络在显式空间交互占主导时更具优势，集成循环混合模型在非线性表格关系与时序动态共存时提供最强性能平衡。

Abstract: This study provides a comprehensive benchmarking of conventional machine learning (ML), ensemble learning, deep neural networks, recurrent architectures, Transformers, graph based models, and hybrid ensemble deep learning approaches under complementary renewable energy scenarios. Three datasets are considered: a large scale WEC dataset, a 16 WEC dataset, and operational 10 min SCADA measurements at the Penmanshiel wind farm. For structured WEC layout data, tree ensembles exhibited a clear advantage over conventional ML and neural predictors because randomized partitioning and boosting efficiently captured nonlinear layout power interactions without requiring explicit feature representation learning. The Extra Trees was the strongest model, achieving considerable results. Relative to the MLP baseline, this corresponds to an approximately 63.7% reduction in MAE, demonstrating the suitability of randomized tree ensembles for high dimensional structured WEC data. Also, STGCN reduced the MAE to approximately 167.0 kW and achieved R = 0.93 by explicitly learning spatial and temporal turbine interactions. The best overall forecasting accuracy was obtained by the RF BiLSTM hybrid, with an MAE=150.5 kW. Compared with standalone LSTM, this represents an approximately 75% reduction in MAE, while improving on STGCN by approximately 10.0%. Finally, the experiments reveal that no single AI architecture is universally optimal: randomized and boosted ensembles are particularly effective for structured WEC surrogate modeling, graph networks become advantageous when explicit spatial interactions dominate, and ensemble recurrent hybrids provide the strongest balance when nonlinear tabular relationships and temporal dynamics coexist.

</details>


### [277] [Robust Neural Stimulation Response Modeling Through Meta-Learning and Pretraining](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26649)
*Matthew J Bryan,Daniel C Muir,Felix Schwock,Azadeh Yazdan-Shahmorad,Rajesh P N Rao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文首次证明元学习和预训练可应用于神经刺激响应建模，通过基于MAML的跨会话预训练方法扩展时间基函数模型，在40个光遗传刺激会话（两只非人灵长类）中显著降低了灾难性预测失败率（R²<0.05的会话从16个降至1个），并将校准数据需求减少50-90%，为模型驱动的闭环神经刺激部署扫清了关键障碍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模型驱动的闭环神经刺激在帕金森病治疗和感觉恢复等领域前景广阔，但两大障碍限制了其部署：1）刺激后果预测模型在相当一部分会话中灾难性失效；2）逐会话校准要求常与临床约束不兼容。此前尚无研究探索元学习和预训练在神经刺激响应建模中的应用。

Method: 采用时间基函数模型（TBFMs）预测状态依赖的神经刺激响应，并提出一种基于模型无关元学习（MAML）的新型架构和算法实现跨会话预训练。在两个非人灵长类初级感觉运动皮层进行40次光遗传刺激会话评估。

Result: 元学习大幅降低灾难性预测失败：在1k校准集规模下，测试R²<0.05的会话从单会话训练的16/40降至MAML预训练的1个；预测区间显著更窄（p<0.05）；在匹配精度下校准需求减少50-90%，使原本在临床会话时间内不可行的实验变为可能。

Conclusion: 刺激响应的跨会话结构具有足够的一致性以支持预训练，为元学习方法在神经刺激中的可行性提供了首个经验证据。鲁棒性和样本效率的提升直接解决了模型驱动刺激控制器部署的已知障碍，激励社区建立标准化多站点刺激数据集并进一步探索元学习在鲁棒闭环刺激中的应用。

Abstract: Objective: Model-based closed-loop neural stimulation holds promise for therapeutic applications ranging from Parkinson's disease to sensory restoration, but deployment has been limited by two obstacles: 1) forecasting models for predicting the consequences of stimulation fail catastrophically on a meaningful fraction of sessions, and 2) per-session calibration requirements are often incompatible with clinical constraints. We address both by demonstrating, for the first time, that meta-learning and pretraining can be applied to neural stimulation response modeling. Methods: Temporal basis function models (TBFMs) forecast state-dependent neural responses to stimulation. We extend TBFMs with cross-session pretraining using a novel architecture and algorithm based on model-agnostic meta-learning (MAML), evaluating them on 40 sessions of optogenetic stimulation in primary sensorimotor cortex of two non-human primates. Results: Meta-learning substantially reduces catastrophic forecast failure: for a 1k calibration set size, sessions with test R-squared < 0.05 drop from 16 of 40 (single-session training) to 1 (MAML-pretrained), and prediction intervals become significantly narrower (p < 0.05). Calibration requirements are reduced by 50-90% at matched accuracy, enabling experiments otherwise infeasible within clinical session-time constraints. Conclusion: Our results demonstrate that cross-session structure in stimulation responses is consistent enough to support pretraining, providing the first empirical evidence that meta-learning approaches are viable for neural stimulation. Significance: The robustness and sample efficiency gains directly address known obstacles to deploying model-based stimulation controllers. Our results motivate community efforts to assemble standardized multi-site stimulation datasets and to further explore meta-learning for robust closed-loop stimulation.

</details>


### [278] [When Privacy Hurts Mergeability: Geometry-Aware Model Merging under Differential Privacy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26655)
*Jin Liu,Junkang Liu,Ning Xi,Yinbin Miao,Dawei Wei,Ke Cheng,Jianfeng Ma*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文首次系统地研究了差分隐私（DP）模型合并的几何特性，提出了两个阻碍私有任务模型合并的几何障碍——局部尖锐度（local sharpness）和参考漂移（reference drift），并据此设计了DP-Merging框架，通过DP兼容的尖锐度感知目标和基于参考的对齐正则化来提升私有任务模型的可合并性，在视觉和语言任务上验证了其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模型合并在无需原始任务数据的情况下构架多任务模型，但发布的任务模型可能泄露私有微调数据。差分隐私提供了限制此类泄露的机制，但其对模型合并的影响尚未被充分理解。本文旨在从几何角度解释为何私有任务模型难以合并，并提出相应的改进方案。

Method: 本文首先从几何角度识别了两个阻碍私有任务模型合并的问题：(1) 局部尖锐度（local sharpness），使任务损失对合并引起的参数位移敏感；(2) 参考漂移（reference drift），衡量私有任务模型偏离共享预训练初始化的程度，会放大跨任务干扰。基于此，提出DP-Merging框架，包含两个关键组件：一个DP兼容的尖锐度感知目标以引导模型朝向更平坦的损失区域，以及一个基于参考的对齐正则化以保持任务模型接近共享预训练初始化。此外还推导了合并间隙（merge-gap）上界，证明降低局部曲率和参考漂移可以收紧该上界。

Result: 在多个视觉和语言任务以及多个隐私预算下的实验表明，DP-Merging在保持底层DP微调过程的隐私保证不变的前提下，一致地提升了私有合并模型的性能。

Conclusion: 本文揭示了差分隐私模型合并中存在的几何障碍，并提出了一个几何感知的DP-Merging框架来改善私有任务模型的可合并性，在隐私保护和多任务性能之间取得了更好的平衡，为隐私保护场景下的模型合并提供了新的理论理解和实用方案。

Abstract: Model merging promises to construct a single multi-task model from independently fine-tuned task models without accessing the original task data. This makes it attractive when task data cannot be centralized, but released task models may still leak private fine-tuning data. Differential privacy (DP) provides a principled mechanism for limiting such leakage, yet its effect on model merging remains poorly understood. In this paper, we study the geometry of differentially private model merging and identify two geometric obstacles that make private task models difficult to merge: \emph{local sharpness}, which makes task losses sensitive to the parameter displacement induced by merging, and \emph{reference drift}, which measures the displacement of private task models from the shared pretrained initialization and amplifies cross-task interference. Based on these observations, we propose \textbf{DP-Merging}, a geometry-aware framework that improves the mergeability of differentially private task models. DP-Merging uses a DP-compatible sharpness-aware objective to guide each private task model toward flatter loss regions, and a reference-based alignment regularizer to keep task models close to the shared pretrained initialization. We derive a merge-gap upper bound showing that reducing local curvature and reference drift tightens the bound on the loss increase induced by merging. Experiments on vision and language tasks across multiple privacy budgets show that DP-Merging consistently improves private merged-model performance while preserving the privacy guarantees of the underlying DP fine-tuning procedures.

</details>


### [279] [Simple Actors and Deep Critics for Scalable Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26659)
*Guhyeon Kang,Jaehwi Lee,Minhae Kwon*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出LAC（轻量Actor、深度Critic）方法，将离线RL中的模型容量从生成式actor转移到critic上，在保持与扩散/流匹配策略相当性能的同时，实现高达4倍更低的推理延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离线RL中生成式actor（如扩散、流匹配策略）虽然能捕捉多模态行为，但每次决策需要进行多次去噪或积分步骤，导致部署时推理开销巨大。作者重新审视actor-critic方法中容量应该投入的位置，由于critic仅在训练时使用而actor在部署时每步执行，将容量分配到critic而非actor更有利于推理效率。

Method: 作者识别出离线RL中加深MLP critic的三种不同失效模式：优化问题、自举噪声放大和值域漂移，并分别用三个对应组件解决：(1) 残差MLP主干解决优化问题；(2) n步自举目标解决自举噪声放大；(3) 分类交叉熵损失解决值域漂移。将这些组件与轻量确定性actor结合，提出LAC（Light Actor, deep Critic）方法。

Result: 在OGBench基准上，LAC匹配了最强的扩散和流匹配基线，同时实现高达4倍更低的推理延迟，与单步蒸馏策略相当但无需蒸馏过程。其critic配方也能跨不同actor参数化迁移。

Conclusion: 通过在离线actor-critic方法中重新分配容量，将深度赋予critic而非生成式actor，可以在不牺牲性能的前提下显著降低推理延迟，为离线RL的部署效率提供了新的设计思路。

Abstract: Recent progress in offline reinforcement learning (RL) has been driven by expressive generative actors such as diffusion and flow-matching policies, which capture multimodal behavior in offline datasets. However, these actors require multiple denoising or integration steps per action and thus incur substantial overhead at every decision in deployment. In this work, we revisit where capacity should be invested in an offline actor--critic method. Since the critic is used only during training and is discarded at deployment while the actor runs at every decision step, allocating capacity to the critic rather than the actor is more favorable for inference-time efficiency. However, scaling MLP critics in offline RL is known to introduce several distinct instabilities that have, in practice, kept critics shallow. We identify three distinct failure modes that arise when critics are deepened in offline RL---optimization, bootstrap-noise amplification, and value-range drift---and address each with a corresponding ingredient: a residual MLP backbone, n-step bootstrap targets, and a categorical cross-entropy loss. Combining these ingredients with a lightweight deterministic actor, we propose LAC (Light Actor, deep Critic). On OGBench, LAC matches the strongest diffusion- and flow-matching baselines while achieving up to 4x lower inference latency, comparable to one-step distilled policies without distillation. Its critic recipe also transfers across actor parametrizations.

</details>


### [280] [Neural Regression with Embeddings for Numerical Attribute Prediction in Knowledge Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26729)
*Rupesh Sapkota,Louis Mozart Kamdem Teyou,Moshood Yekini,Caglar Demir,Axel-Cyrille Ngonga Ngomo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出LitEm——一个神经回归模型，使直推式知识图谱嵌入模型能够预测知识图谱中的数值属性。同时提出共训练框架，将SOTA直推式知识图谱嵌入模型与LitEm联合训练，在不增加推理负担的情况下提升链接预测性能（尤其是双线性模型）并赋予其数值属性预测能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 知识图谱中往往包含丰富的数值属性，但大多数嵌入模型忽略这些信息，限制了其表示具有多样信息知识图谱的能力。

Method: 1) 提出LitEm神经回归模型，用于预测知识图谱中的数值属性；2) 提出共训练框架，将直推式知识图谱嵌入模型与LitEm联合训练，使模型同时获得链接预测和数值属性预测能力，并通过literal-aware评估验证性能提升不是仅由额外参数带来的。

Result: LitEm在FB15K-237、YAGO15K、DB15K和Mutagenesis数据集上对大多数属性取得最好或第二好的结果。共训练框架主要提升双线性模型的链接预测性能，同时使其具备数值属性预测能力。

Conclusion: 共训练能够帮助模型以"literal-aware"方式编码和利用属性信息，表明性能提升并非仅来自额外参数，实现已公开发布。

Abstract: In recent years, transductive knowledge graph embedding models have been applied to tasks such as link prediction and query answering. Although knowledge graphs often contain rich numerical attributes, most embedding models neglect them, limiting their ability to represent real-world knowledge graphs with diverse information. In this work, we propose a neural regression model (LitEm) that enables transductive knowledge graph embedding models to predict numerical attributes within knowledge graphs. Experimental results demonstrate that LitEm achieves the best or second-best results on most attributes across FB15K-237, YAGO15K, DB15K, and Mutagenesis. Furthermore, we propose a co-training framework that jointly trains state-of-the-art transductive knowledge graph embedding models with LitEm, which improves link prediction performance mainly for bilinear models and simultaneously enables them to predict numerical attributes. In addition, the literal-awareness evaluation demonstrates that co-training helps models to encode and exploit attribute information in a "literal-aware'' manner, suggesting that the observed gains are not merely due to additional parameters. We publicly release our implementation at https://github.com/dice-group/dice-embeddings.

</details>


### [281] [Rethinking Message Passing as Retrieval for Text-Attributed Graph Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26732)
*Jintang Li,Yuhong Chen,Ruofan Wu,Binli Luo,Jiayi Ji,Hui Li,Rongrong Ji*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了RTA框架，从检索增强的角度重新解读GNN，用标签感知的检索与传播替代结构化的消息传递，在多个文本属性图基准上匹配甚至超越强GNN和图LLM基线，同时提升效率和鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管GNN通常被概念化为消息传递神经网络，但邻域聚合为何可靠地优于节点级MLP仍不清楚。此外，消息传递范式计算开销大且对不完美的图结构敏感，需要探索更简单高效的替代方案并揭示其背后的原理。

Method: 提出RTA，一种基于MLP的简单框架：将GNN重新概念化为检索增强的视角——每层通过MLP对节点表示与置换不变的检索图上下文摘要进行预测，用标签感知的检索和传播替代结构化的消息传递。论文还提供了理论分析，将检索聚合与softmax注意力消息传递建立联系，并论证检索上下文监督对错误检索异常值的鲁棒性。

Result: 在多个文本属性图基准上，RTA匹配甚至超越了强GNN和图LLM基线的性能，同时在多种场景下提升了效率与鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 检索增强视角为理解GNN为何有效提供了新思路，RTA验证了简单的基于MLP的检索传播框架可以在性能和效率上超越复杂的消息传递方法，且具备理论上的鲁棒性保证。

Abstract: Graph neural networks (GNNs) are typically conceptualized as message-passing neural networks, yet it remains unclear why neighborhood aggregation reliably outperforms node-wise multilayer perceptrons (MLPs). Despite its empirical success, this paradigm can be computationally expensive and sensitive to imperfect graph structures. In this work, we present a retrieval-augmented view of GNNs: each layer makes predictions by applying an MLP to a node representation together with a permutation-invariant summary of retrieved graph context. Motivated by this perspective, we propose RTA, a simple MLP-based framework that replaces structural message passing with label-aware retrieval and propagation. We provide theoretical insights that (i) connect retrieval-based aggregation to softmax-attention message passing, and (ii) establish the robustness of retrieved-context supervision to mis-retrieved outliers. Experiments on multiple text-attributed graph benchmarks show that RTA matches or even outperforms strong GNN and graph LLM baselines while improving efficiency and robustness across diverse scenarios.

</details>


### [282] [Self-Augmented Diffusion Guidance for Physics-Informed Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26748)
*Akira Osaka,Naoya Takeishi,Takehisa Yairi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种基于扩散引导与自生成数据增强的物理信息扩散模型，通过学习以物理偏差程度为条件的数据分布，在采样时将偏差条件设为零，从而在生成时空物理信号时确保符合物理规律，且无需在每次去噪迭代中求解控制方程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准扩散模型在生成流体动力学等时空物理信号时，不包含来自底层物理规律的约束，导致生成样本虽在视觉上合理但与真实动力学偏差较大。

Method: 将生成模型的训练与采样过程与控制方程的求解解耦：先通过自生成数据增强学习以偏离物理正确动力学程度为条件的数据分布，然后显式将偏差条件设为零进行采样生成，无需在去噪的每次迭代中求解控制方程。

Result: 实验表明，相比标准扩散模型，该方法显著降低了与物理规律的偏差；与现有物理约束扩散方法结合时，可实现进一步的偏差降低。

Conclusion: 该方法简单有效，适用于需要昂贵数值模拟的问题，并能加速样本生成，为物理信息生成模型提供了新的思路。

Abstract: Diffusion models can be used to generate spatiotemporal signals of physical phenomena, such as time-series images of fluid dynamics. However, a major limitation of standard diffusion models is that they do not incorporate constraints derived from the underlying physical laws. Consequently, generated samples may appear visually plausible while deviating substantially from the true dynamics. In this study, we propose a simple yet effective physics-informed approach based on diffusion guidance with self-generated data augmentation. The proposed method learns the data distribution conditioned on the degree of deviation from the physically correct dynamics and generates samples by explicitly setting the deviation condition to be zero. The method decouples the evaluation of the governing equations from the diffusion model training and sampling processes, avoiding the need to solve the governing equations at every iteration of the denoising process. This design makes the method applicable to problems requiring computationally expensive numerical simulations and enables faster sample generation. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed model not only significantly reduces the deviations compared with standard diffusion models but also achieves further reductions when combined with existing physics-constrained diffusion methods.

</details>


### [283] [Safety by Design: Realized-Cost Constraints for Contextual Bandits with Continuous Actions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26755)
*Spyros Dragazis,Aldo Pacchiano*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究上下文赌博机中的高概率约束问题，提出High-Probability Constrained UCB（乐观-悲观）算法，在考虑实现在成本高概率约束的前提下优化奖励，证明了线性模型下紧的O(d√T)遗憾界，并通过实验验证其比期望成本约束方法显著减少违规。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有安全约束赌博机模型通常要求每轮动作的期望成本低于设定阈值，但在异方差场景中，所选动作不仅影响期望收益和成本，还影响观测结果的方差，因此仅约束期望成本可能不足以保证安全。单次不安全决策（如剂量选择、自动驾驶）可能带来灾难性后果，需要更严格的高概率约束。

Method: 提出High-Probability Constrained UCB算法，采用乐观-悲观策略：在探索奖励时乐观估计，同时在保守估计安全动作集时悲观处理。动作空间为一维连续，约束为逐阶段（stage-wise）实现在成本的高概率约束。对线性奖励/成本模型证明O(d√T)遗憾界，并通过eluder维度将分析推广到一般函数类。

Result: 在线性奖励和成本模型下证明了紧的Õ(d√T)遗憾界；分析通过eluder维度扩展到一般函数类；实验表明，相比于期望成本约束的基线方法，强制执行实现在成本安全性可显著减少违规次数。

Conclusion: 异构方差场景下，仅约束期望成本不足以保证安全，需要在高概率意义上约束实现在成本。所提出的HPC-UCB算法在理论和实验上均验证了其在保证安全性的同时保持次线性遗憾，为安全关键应用提供了更可靠的理论基础。

Abstract: Contextual bandits are a standard framework for sequential decision-making under uncertainty, with applications in clinical trials, dosage selection, recommendation systems, and autonomous systems. Safety is central in many of these applications, since a single unsafe decision in settings such as dosage selection or autonomous driving can have catastrophic consequences. A common way to model safety in bandit problems is to associate each action with both a reward signal and a cost signal, and to optimize reward subject to constraints on cost. Most existing safety-constrained bandit models enforce safety by requiring the expected cost of each action to remain below a prescribed threshold. However, this may be insufficient in heteroscedastic settings, where the chosen action affects not only the expected reward and cost, but also the variability of the observed outcomes. We study contextual bandits with one-dimensional continuous actions and stage-wise high-probability constraints on the realized cost. We propose High-Probability Constrained UCB, an optimistic-pessimistic algorithm that explores for reward while conservatively estimating the safe action set. For linear reward and cost models, we prove a tight $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(d\sqrt{T})$ regret bound, and we extend the analysis to general function classes using the eluder dimension. Experiments show that enforcing realized-cost safety substantially reduces violations compared with expected-cost constrained baselines.

</details>


### [284] [Beyond Client Averaging: A Client-Independent Second-Order Stationary-Bias Component in Stochastic SCAFFOLD](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26765)
*Yi-Ping Tang,Guan-Ju Peng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对全参与随机Scaffold算法，在单维同质客户端、固定本地步数H、有界加性梯度噪声设定下，推导出平稳均值偏差的显式系数，证明客户端平均虽抑制O(γ/N)主导偏差，但无法消除客户端无关的O(γ²)偏差分量，并通过数值实验验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有随机Scaffold的常数步长分析仅确定主导的O(γ/N)平稳均值偏差，未能在系数层面识别首个与客户端数量无关的贡献项，本文旨在填补这一空白。

Method: 在全参与、一维同质客户端、固定本地步数H和有界加性梯度噪声假设下，推导平稳分布均值偏差的渐近展开式，得到精确到γ²阶的显式系数，并严格证明余项关于N一致有界。通过路径展开分析控制项对局部轨迹二阶矩的间接影响。

Result: 证明平稳均值偏差为−f'''(x*)σ²/(4f''(x*)²)·γ/N − f'''(x*)σ²/(12f''(x*))·(H−1)(5H−1)/H·γ² + O_H(γ²/N + γ³)，且对N≥2一致成立。客户端平均抑制O(γ/N)项但不消除客户端无关的O(γ²)项。

Conclusion: 客户端控制虽然能在线性全局平均中逐路径抵消，但通过改变轮内局部轨迹及其二阶矩，在非二次曲率下转化为平稳均值偏差。系数对二次目标为零；结果限于一维同质固定H设定。

Abstract: Existing constant-step analysis of stochastic \Scaf{} identifies a leading $O(γ/N)$ stationary mean bias and shows that higher-order bias can persist as the client count increases, but does not identify the first client-independent contribution at coefficient level. For full-participation stochastic \Scaf{} with one-dimensional homogeneous clients, fixed local-step count $H$, and bounded additive gradient noise, we prove, uniformly over $N\ge2$,
  $$ \begin{aligned} \mathbb{E}_{π_{γ,N,H}}[x]-x^\star ={}& -\frac{f'''(x^\star)σ^2}{4f''(x^\star)^2}\fracγ{N}\\ &- \frac{f'''(x^\star)σ^2}{12f''(x^\star)} \frac{(H-1)(5H-1)}{H}γ^2 +O_H\!\left(\frac{γ^2}{N}+γ^3\right). \end{aligned} $$
  Hence client averaging suppresses the leading $O(γ/N)$ bias but does not remove the client-independent $O(γ^2)$ component when its coefficient is nonzero.
  The mechanism is indirect: although the direct control contribution cancels pathwise in the linear global average, the controls still alter within-round local trajectories and their second moments. Fresh gradient noise and persistent control fluctuations therefore generate local second-moment corrections that nonquadratic curvature converts into stationary mean bias. The coefficient vanishes for quadratic objectives. Numerical experiments are consistent with the predicted coefficient, its persistence as client count increases, and the stated joint remainder. The result is restricted to the one-dimensional homogeneous fixed-$H$ setting.

</details>


### [285] [On the Indistinguishability of Human v/s AI Generated Text](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26797)
*Jaee Ponde,Aritra Das,Mihir More,Debayan Gupta*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究在多次采样框架下，利用人类写作样本作为参考，通过重复改写将机器生成文本的分布向人类分布靠拢的理论方法，并给出了收敛速率和采样复杂度分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着LLM的快速发展，区分AI生成文本与人类写作已成为紧迫问题，而改写工具进一步加剧了这一挑战。作者希望探索是否有方法可以反向利用人类写作样本，通过策略性改写使机器文本在分布上接近人类，从而理论上理解这一改写过程的极限。

Method: 论文在多次采样（multi-sample）设置下展开理论分析：收集同一提示下的人类和机器响应，研究重复改写如何将机器分布推向经验人类分布。在简单的混合（mixing）和稳定性（stability）条件下，推导出显式的收敛速率，并将分析扩展到有限样本场景，刻画所需人类样本数和改写轮数随目标误差的缩放关系。

Result: 证明了在满足混合性和稳定性条件时，重复改写能使机器生成分布收敛到经验人类分布，给出了明确的收敛速率表达式；在有限样本下，推导了所需人类样本数量与改写轮次如何随期望误差增长而缩放。

Conclusion: 该工作为理解LLM文本改写向人类分布收敛的理论性质提供了基础，量化了人类样本数量和改写轮次与改写效果之间的关系。

Abstract: The rapid improvement of LLMs has made distinguishing AI-generated text from human writing a pressing problem. This challenge is further amplified by paraphrasing tools designed to make machine-generated text appear more "human". We study how access to human writing samples can be used to strategically paraphrase machine-generated responses toward the human distribution. Under a multi-sample setting with human and machine responses to the same prompts, we show that repeated paraphrasing moves the machine distribution toward the empirical human distribution under simple mixing and stability conditions. Our results derive an explicit convergence rate, extend the analysis to a finite-sample setting, and characterize how the required number of human samples and paraphrasing rounds scale with the desired error.

</details>


### [286] [SAGE: Variate-Wise Semantic Augmentation for Vision-Language Time Series Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26829)
*Haizhao Fan,Xinyi Le*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SAGE是一个端到端的CLIP-based时间序列预测框架，通过联合建模时间、跨变量、文本和视觉信息，在八个长期基准和M4数据集上取得了最先进的预测精度，且无需在预测循环中引入LLM。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有时间序列预测模型仅处理原始数值序列，缺乏领域专家隐含的语义知识（如变量的物理含义、统计行为和时间动态）。已有的弥补方案要么在推理时依赖大语言模型导致计算开销大，要么在数据集层面使用统一的文本提示，忽略了各变量间的异构语义。

Method: 提出SAGE框架：1) 使用CLIP文本编码器处理频率增强的patch和变量token，通过门控残差路径注入变量特定描述和统计描述符；2) 使用冻结的CLIP视觉编码器通过训练时的对比学习目标将渲染的序列与时间表示对齐；3) 双重使用CLIP提供互补的语义和视觉监督而不将LLM置于预测循环中。

Result: 在八个长期预测基准和M4数据集上，SAGE取得了最先进的预测精度。消融实验证实了多模态对齐和变量级知识带来的互补增益。

Conclusion: SAGE通过端到端的多模态对齐框架，在不依赖LLM推理的前提下有效地将语义知识注入时间序列预测模型，验证了文本-视觉-时间多模态融合在时间序列预测中的有效性。

Abstract: Time series forecasting models operate on raw numerical sequences, lacking the semantic knowledge that domain experts implicitly leverage, such as the physical meaning of each variable, its statistical behavior, and its temporal dynamics. Recent efforts to bridge this gap fall into two camps. Some rely on large language models at inference time, which is computationally expensive. Others apply uniform textual prompts at the dataset level, ignoring the heterogeneous semantics across individual variates. We propose SAGE (Seeing and Augmenting with Grounded Encoding), an end-to-end CLIP-based framework that jointly models temporal, cross-variable, textual, and visual information. The CLIP text encoder processes frequency-enhanced patches and variable tokens, while gated residual paths inject variable-specific descriptions and statistical descriptors. In parallel, the frozen CLIP vision encoder aligns rendered series with temporal representations through a training-only contrastive objective. This dual use of CLIP adds complementary semantic and visual supervision without placing an LLM in the forecasting loop. Across eight long-term benchmarks and M4, SAGE achieves state-of-the-art accuracy. Ablations confirm complementary gains from multimodal alignment and variable-level knowledge.

</details>


### [287] [Reinforcement Learning-Based Control of CAV Platoon Joining Maneuvers in Mixed Traffic](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26860)
*Biao Yin,Abderrahmane Kasmi,Nadir Farhi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个用于研究CAV队列加入机动并比较深度强化学习控制算法的通用建模与仿真框架，在混合交通环境中评估DQN、DDQN和PPO三种算法。结果显示PPO表现最优（加入成功率约98%，碰撞率低于1%），但需要更多决策步数；外部安全控制器能有效防止碰撞但会降低加入效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CAV队列控制在实际交通中面临不确定性和异构驾驶行为的挑战，强化学习虽具潜力但其实际部署存在安全性和学习效率方面的难题，需要系统性地研究和比较不同DRL算法在队列加入场景中的表现。

Method: 提出一个基于智能体的建模框架，与SUMO仿真器耦合，在混合交通环境中评估三种DRL算法（DQN、DDQN、PPO）。通过在奖励函数中引入风险惩罚或使用外部安全控制器两种方式来保证安全，并比较其在加入成功率、碰撞率和决策效率方面的表现。

Result: PPO优于DQN和DDQN，加入成功率约98%、碰撞率低于1%，这主要归功于奖励函数中的风险相关惩罚。但PPO需要更多决策步数完成机动，显示安全、加入有效性和决策效率之间存在权衡。外部安全控制器可有效防止碰撞，但可能降低加入效率。

Conclusion: 在混合交通中设计基于RL的CAV队列加入控制器时，必须同时考虑安全性和效率的权衡，风险惩罚和外部安全控制器各有优劣，应根据具体需求选择合适的安全保障策略。

Abstract: Connected and automated vehicle (CAV) platooning offers a promising approach to improving road safety and traffic capacity. However, platoon control in real-world traffic is challenging due to uncertainty and heterogeneous driving behaviors. Reinforcement learning (RL) has strong potential for addressing such control problems, but its practical deployment raises challenges related to safety and learning efficiency. This paper proposes a generic modeling and simulation framework for investigating CAV platoon joining maneuvers and comparing deep reinforcement learning (DRL)-based control algorithms. The problem is particularly challenging in mixed-traffic environments, where CAVs coexist with human-driven vehicles exhibiting heterogeneous longitudinal and lateral behaviors. The objective is to achieve safe and efficient joining maneuvers by either incorporating penalties for risky behaviors into the learning process or using an external safety controller to constrain the learned policy. An agent-based modeling framework coupled with the Simulation of Urban MObility (SUMO) simulator is used to evaluate Deep Q-Network (DQN), Double Deep Q-Network (DDQN), and Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO). Results show that PPO outperforms DQN and DDQN, achieving a joining success rate of approximately 98 % and a collision rate below 1 %, largely due to risk-related penalties incorporated into the reward function. However, this improved performance requires more decision steps to complete the maneuver, revealing a trade-off between safety, joining effectiveness, and decision efficiency. An external safety controller effectively prevents collisions, although its interventions may reduce joining efficiency. The results highlight the importance of jointly considering safety and efficiency when designing RL-based controllers for CAV platoon joining in mixed traffic.

</details>


### [288] [When Is the Sharp Covariance Envelope Tight? Feature-Only Geometry for Volume-Sampled Least Squares](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26877)
*Kihun Rhee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对普通索引固定大小体积采样（ordinary indexed fixed-size volume sampling）后接选定的未加权最小二乘估计，建立了中心化系数协方差的Loewner包络（envelope），该包络在全部满秩池、响应与合法预算d ≤ s ≤ m上全局尖锐。文章还通过余数增强的测度变换、支持饱和、临界等杠杆几何等技术手段，在正损失、严格内部预算和无coloops条件下给出了精确的固定设计谱相判定（nu_A > 0与nu_A = 0的充要条件），并提供了保守的解算器与冻结特征下的非空洞性验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 先前Derezinski和Warmuth的分析确立了全体采样恒等式、选定OLS无偏性以及普通体积采样的逆矩，但其精确的任意固定响应损失与预测协方差公式仅在秩-维度端点s=d处成立。本文旨在将这一理论推广到完整的合法预算范围d ≤ s ≤ m，并建立全局尖锐的中心化系数协方差边界。

Method: 本文采用以下技术路线：(1) 建立全秩固定池下中心化系数协方差的Loewner包络，并证明其系数在满秩类上全局尖锐；(2) 引入仅特征边际nu_A刻画固定设计谱相，给出nu_A > 0与nu_A = 0的精确充要条件；(3) 通过残差增强的测度变换（residual-augmented change of measure）提供响应感知机制与单侧定量松弛界；(4) 利用支持饱和（support saturation）证明可达方向；(5) 用临界等杠杆几何解释边界特征，并给出保守下界证书以支撑相同的原始基数决策。

Result: 对于任意满秩固定池、响应与合法预算，中心化系数协方差在Loewner序下具有全局尖锐的包络系数；在正损失、严格内部预算且无coloops条件下，精确谱相判定成立：nu_A > 0当且仅当归一化谱包络对每个兼容残差均严格，nu_A = 0当且仅当存在某个兼容残差在谱上紧致，且同一零边际残差在一切严格内部预算下保持紧致。冻结特征实例表明该证书非空洞，并度量了授权降维的固定池代价。

Conclusion: 本文的论断涉及条件中心化、全Gram白化（full-Gram-whitened）后的系数协方差，而非总体泛化。文章将先前的端点结果推广至整个合法预算区间，建立了严格且全局尖锐的协方差边界，并给出了响应感知的精确谱相刻画及保守的实用证书，为体积采样下的系数协方差分析提供了完整的理论框架。

Abstract: Prior analyses by Derezinski and Warmuth established all-size sampling identities, selected-OLS unbiasedness, and inverse moments for ordinary volume sampling, while their exact arbitrary-fixed-response loss and prediction-covariance formulas are at the rank-size endpoint s=d. We establish a Loewner envelope for centered coefficient covariance for every full-rank fixed pool, response, and legal budget d <= s <= m under ordinary indexed fixed-size volume sampling followed by selected unweighted least squares; its coefficient is globally sharp over the full-rank class. Global sharpness does not determine attainability on the pool in hand. Under positive loss, strict-interior budgets, and no coloops, a feature-only margin nu_A gives the exact fixed-design spectral phase: nu_A > 0 if and only if the normalized spectral envelope is strict for every compatible residual, whereas nu_A = 0 if and only if some compatible residual is spectrally tight; the same zero-margin residual is tight at every strict-interior budget. A residual-augmented change of measure supplies the response-aware mechanism and a one-sided quantitative slack bound, while support saturation proves the attainment direction. Critical equal-leverage geometry interprets the boundary, and sound lower certificates yield conservative same-primitive cardinality decisions. Frozen-feature examples show that the certificate is nonvacuous and measure the fixed-pool cost of its authorized reduction. The claims concern conditional centered, full-Gram-whitened coefficient covariance, not population generalization.

</details>


### [289] [Mitigating Strong-Modality Collapse in Multimodal Learning via Inverted Asymmetric Fusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26879)
*Mary Ogbuka Kenneth,Foaad Khosmood,Abbas Edalat*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出逆向非对称融合（IAF）框架来解决多模态融合中"强模态坍缩"问题，即融合过程导致主导模态内部表征退化，使多模态模型无法超越最优单模态基线。IAF通过让主导模态原样通过融合层、弱模态以其为上下文锚点进行关注，并结合模态感知知识蒸馏来强化弱模态，在三个基准数据集上相较最强单模态基线提升最高8.25%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态融合期望提升模型性能，但在MultiHuSE数据集上，早期、晚期和对称注意力融合均未能超越最优单模态（文本）基线。通过通路隔离发现，对称注意力融合使文本通路的准确率从74.9%降至56.4%，说明主导模态在融合过程中被退化。这一现象被命名为"强模态坍缩"，是解释多模态模型无法超越单模态基线的重要原因。

Method: 提出逆向非对称融合（Inverted Asymmetric Fusion, IAF）框架：1) 主导模态原样通过融合层，避免强制跨模态注意力对主导模态造成干扰；2) 弱模态以主导模态为上下文锚点进行注意力计算；3) 融合前使用模态感知知识蒸馏（Modality-Aware Knowledge Distillation）增强弱模态的表征能力。

Result: 在三个具有不同模态层级的基准数据集上评估：文本主导的MultiHuSE和UR-FUNNY，以及音视频主导的MUStARD。通路隔离实验表明，IAF在所有测试配置下都能将主导模态的内部准确率保持在单模态上限水平，而对称融合在MultiHuSE上使主导模态降级高达18.5%。IAF相较最强单模态基线提升最高8.25%。

Conclusion: IAF通过非对称融合架构有效避免强模态坍缩，在融合多模态信息的同时保护主导模态的内部表征不被退化，从而在多类模态层级分布的数据集上稳定超越单模态基线。该工作揭示了对称融合中主导模态退化的机制，并为多模态融合架构设计提供了新思路。

Abstract: Fusing multiple modalities is expected to improve model performance. However, on the MultiHuSE dataset, early, late, and symmetric attention fusion often fail to outperform the best unimodal baseline (text). Pathway isolation of a symmetric attention fusion model reveals that the text-pathway accuracy drops from 74.9% to 56.4% after fusion in one such setting, indicating that the dominant modality can be degraded during integration. We term this strong-modality collapse and argue that it helps explain why some multimodal models fail to surpass unimodal baselines. We propose Inverted Asymmetric Fusion (IAF), which avoids forcing mutual attention across modalities. The dominant modality is preserved by passing through fusion unchanged, while weaker modalities attend to it as a contextual anchor. Before fusion, weaker modalities are strengthened using Modality-Aware Knowledge Distillation. We evaluate IAF on three benchmarks with different modality hierarchies: text-dominant datasets (MultiHuSE, UR-FUNNY) and an audio-visual-dominant dataset (MUStARD). Pathway isolation shows that IAF preserves the dominant modality's internal accuracy at its unimodal ceiling across all tested configurations, whereas symmetric fusion degrades it by up to 18.5% on MultiHuSE. IAF improves over the strongest unimodal baseline by up to 8.25%.

</details>


### [290] [A Layer Importance Metric for Quantization Accounting for the Speed-Quality Trade-off in Autoregressive Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26926)
*Artem Safronov*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种复合度量方法，结合信息保持（基于归一化SQNR系数）和吞吐量增益（基于roofline延迟分析），用于在小语言模型（sLLM）的量化推理中优先选择加速目标（如FFN块和嵌入矩阵），无需实际执行即可预测加速效果，预测误差约4%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 小语言模型部署在内存和计算资源受限的设备上，自回归推理受内存带宽限制。均匀量化对小模型往往有害，因为其架构冗余有限，仅有少数层对低精度不敏感。需要一种系统性的方法来识别哪些层最适合量化加速。

Method: 提出复合优先级系数，由两个正交指标组成：(1) 归一化SQNR系数的信息保持度量；(2) 基于roofline模型的归一化速度评分（无需实际执行）。通过对Gemma 3 1B进行剖析，发现FFN块和嵌入矩阵是最佳加速目标。该方法可推广到单个块、投影子层或整个Transformer层。

Result: 在多种模型架构上评估，加速速度预测误差约为4%。与进化搜索、专用加速器和基于Shapley值的方法相比，该方法能将更多资源分配给最具表达力的层，且无需昂贵的近似推理。

Conclusion: 该分析方法使小语言模型的量化成为可预测的工程任务，可灵活调节速度与质量之间的权衡，具有通用性和无需实际执行的优势。

Abstract: Small language models (sLLMs) are nowadays hosted on devices with limited memory and computational budget. In an autoregressive setup, inference is memory-bandwidth bound: uniform quantization is often detrimental to such models, since their architecture has limited redundancies and only a few layers are not very sensitive to lower precision. We propose a composite metric that combines two orthogonal criteria: information retention (measured in terms of a normalized SQNR-based coefficient) and throughput gains (modeled using a roofline-based latency analysis). By profiling Gemma 3 1B, we find that Feed-Forward Network blocks and the embedding matrix are the most promising targets for acceleration. For each candidate, we estimate a normalized quality score based on simulated quantization and a normalized speed score based on roofline modeling with no actual execution needed. We combine the two scores in a composite priority coefficient, allowing us to tune the trade-off between speed and quality as needed. Our metric is general and can be used to prioritize individual blocks, their projection sublayers, or transformer layers as a whole. We evaluate our approach on several model architectures, showing that our estimates have at around 4% prediction error for the accelerated speedup. We find that our method generally allocates more resources to the most expressive layers compared to evolutionary search, specialized accelerators, or Shapley-value-based approaches that require expensive approximate inference. Our analytical approach makes sLLM quantization a predictable engineering task.

</details>


### [291] [Scaling Model-Generated Distillation Data Can Make Latent Teacher Traits More Recoverable](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26958)
*Zhichen Dong,Zhixuan Liu,Yuyu Fan,Xiangtian Li,Shuyang Zhang,Chao Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文发现缩放模型生成数据除改善蒸馏外还有第二个效应：更大的数据集会使教师模型的特质信号更容易在学生模型中显现，即使数据是离题的或从未提及该特质。在受控的"潜意识学习"实验中，教师表达的目标特质通过离题数据（如纯数字补全）传递给学生，更大规模的独立数据使教师的诱导特质在学生后续行为中更突出，且该效应跨模型家族、特质类型和多特质设定稳定存在。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统观点认为缩放生成数据仅通过增加覆盖率和降低噪声来改善蒸馏效果。本文质疑这一简化视角，提出可能存在的第二效应：更大的数据集可能使微妙的教师特质信号更容易被学生模型检测和学习到，即使这些数据看似离题或良性。这一发现对于理解数据缩放行为、指导蒸馏数据的策展和安全评估具有重要意义。

Method: 在受控实验中，先诱导教师模型表达目标特质，再让教师生成受限的离题数据（如纯数字补全）；随后用不同规模的独立离题数据训练学生模型；在分离的领域评估学生行为，并通过匹配的无特质对照组隔离出目标特异的迁移效应。分析包括行为评估和LoRA更新检查，并涵盖多种模型家族、特质类型、多特质设定和跨模型迁移场景。

Result: 更大的独立数据集使教师的诱导特质在学生后期行为中更清晰地显现；在小规模学生已偏向目标特质时，缩放主要放大该行为；在偏向相关或显著替代特质时，更多数据可将行为转向目标特质。LoRA更新分析显示类似趋势。该效应跨模型家族、特质类型、多特质设定和跨模型迁移均一致出现。

Conclusion: 缩放生成蒸馏数据应配合特质感知的策展和评估，即使数据看似离题或良性，也不能忽视其中隐性的教师特质信号随规模放大而增强的风险。这提示数据规模化不仅是"蒸馏更好"的过程，也可能是"信号放大"的过程。

Abstract: Scaling model-generated data is usually viewed as improving distillation: more examples should increase coverage, reduce noise, and produce stronger students. We show a second effect: larger datasets can make subtle teacher-specific signals easier to detect in the trained student, even when examples are off-task and never mention the trait. In a controlled setup inspired by subliminal learning, a teacher induced to express a target trait generates restricted off-task data, such as number-only completions. Students trained on different amounts of independent off-task data are evaluated in a separate domain, with matched no-trait controls isolating target-specific transfer. Our main finding is that larger independent datasets make the teacher's induced trait stand out more clearly in the student's later behavior. Other plausible traits may also strengthen with scale, but the target usually grows more. When the small-scale student already favors the target, scaling mainly amplifies that behavior; when it favors a related or salient alternative, more data can shift behavior toward the intended trait. Analyses of learned LoRA updates show a parallel trend. These effects appear across model families, trait types, multi-trait settings, and cross-model transfer. Our results suggest that scaling generated distillation data should be paired with trait-aware curation and evaluation, even when the data appears off-task or benign.

</details>


### [292] [Gromov-Monge Flow Matching for Equivariant Graph Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26961)
*Moritz Piening,Christian Wald*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种结构感知的耦合方法（structure-aware couplings）用于图生成中的流匹配（flow matching）模型。作者从理论上论证了在图商空间（graph quotient space）中，最优节点重标记的Gromov–Monge距离构成自然的最优传输几何，证明了商空间耦合可无损地提升为对齐表示，且对称化能获得等变流匹配最小化器。由于精确对齐不可行，实践中采用Gromov–Wasserstein类松弛与小批量耦合来逼近。该方法仅修改训练耦合，与标准置换等变架构兼容，在连续图生成和分子生成任务中显著提升了小积分预算下的样本质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图具有节点置换不变性，现有的置换等变架构虽然利用了图的对称性，但在流匹配中源-目标耦合（source-target coupling）的构造忽视了对称性。当图对在节点重标记意义下比较时，自然的Wasserstein几何应存在于图商空间而非欧氏空间，然而此前缺少对这一视角的理论分析和有效的实践方案。

Method: 1) 理论上证明图商空间中的欧氏商度量与Gromov–Monge距离一致，即通过最优节点重标记获得；2) 证明商空间耦合可无损提升为对齐的表示，且对称化可得到等变的流匹配最小化器（含分类端点预测）；3) 实践中因精确Gromov–Monge对齐难以计算，采用高效的Gromov–Wasserstein类松弛和内部节点对齐的下界构造小批量耦合，可选地结合图间外层分配；4) 该方法仅替换训练耦合，无需修改架构。

Result: 在连续图生成和分类分子生成任务上，结构感知耦合在较小的积分预算下显著提升了样本质量；在更大规模的分子模型中，在传统多步采样下仍保持竞争力。

Conclusion: 将图的置换对称性纳入流匹配的训练耦合（而非仅架构）对提升生成质量至关重要。基于Gromov–Wasserstein的近似对齐耦合为等变图生成提供了一种有效、兼容且可扩展的训练策略，未来可进一步探索更精确的图对齐算法与更大规模生成任务。

Abstract: Graphs are invariant under node permutations, motivating the use of permutation-equivariant architectures in generative models. In flow matching, however, symmetry may also enter the source--target coupling: once graph pairs are compared up to node relabeling, the natural Wasserstein geometry is that of the graph quotient space. The Euclidean quotient metric of this space coincides with the Gromov--Monge distance, obtained by optimally relabeling the nodes. We develop this perspective theoretically, showing that quotient couplings can be lifted to aligned representatives without additional cost and that symmetrization yields equivariant flow-matching minimizers, including for categorical endpoint prediction. In practice, exact Gromov--Monge alignment is intractable, so we construct minibatch couplings using efficient Gromov--Wasserstein-type relaxations and lower bounds for the inner node alignment, optionally combined with an outer assignment between graphs. The resulting procedure changes only the training coupling and is compatible with standard permutation-equivariant architectures. Across continuous graph and categorical molecular generation, these structure-aware couplings substantially improve sample quality at small integration budgets, while our scaled-up molecular models remain competitive under conventional many-step sampling.

</details>


### [293] [Packora: Systematic Design for Generative Molecular Crystal Structure Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26962)
*Nayoung Kim,Kiyoung Seong,Sungsoo Ahn*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Packora，一种基于流的生成式分子晶体结构预测（CSP）模型，可从分子图联合预测原子坐标和晶格参数，支持多组分、有机金属晶体及多种条件输入，在生成和排序基准上均优于基线，达到最佳匹配预算覆盖率和更高的实验形态恢复率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分子晶体结构预测（CSP）在制药、农化和有机电子等领域至关重要，因为分子构象和堆积的细微差异会显著影响材料性质。然而现有方法在生成和排序能力上仍有不足，缺乏统一的、能够处理多组分和多种条件信息的生成式CSP模型。

Method: Packora采用基于流的生成模型框架，从分子图出发联合预测原子坐标和晶格。模型支持多组分和有机金属晶体，并可在单一模型中任意条件化分子构象子集、立体化学标签和空间群信息。作者将CCDC CSP盲测的启发扩展到评估中，分开展生成和排序评估；并系统研究了架构、训练、条件化、推理和扩展策略，确定了基于可缓存成对推理、训练目标与数值求解器选择、条件化dropout以及成对与单表示平衡扩展的有效设计。

Result: Packora在结构生成和排序基准上均优于基线，在全部六个生成基准上取得最佳匹配预算覆盖率，并实现更高的实验形态恢复率、更低的实验形态排名以及更快的排序收敛速度。

Conclusion: Packora通过统一的流式生成框架和系统化的设计优化，在分子晶体结构预测的生成和排序两个环节均取得了显著改进，验证了其在复杂晶体体系（包括多组分和有机金属）上的有效性和通用性。

Abstract: Molecular crystal structure prediction (CSP) is important in pharmaceuticals, agrochemicals, and organic electronics, where subtle differences in molecular conformation and packing can strongly affect material properties. We present Packora, a flow-based generative model for molecular CSP that jointly predicts atomic coordinates and the lattice from molecular graphs. Packora supports multi-component and organometallic crystals and can condition on any subset of molecular conformers, stereochemical labels, and space-group information within a single model. Inspired by the CCDC CSP blind test, we evaluate generation and ranking separately, using generation to isolate generator quality and ranking to measure end-to-end performance under a common relaxation and ranking pipeline. We also systematically study architecture, training, conditioning, inference, and scaling, identifying an effective design based on cacheable pairwise reasoning, training objective and numerical solver choices, conditioning dropout, and balanced scaling of pairwise and single representations. Packora outperforms the baselines on both structure generation and ranking benchmarks, achieving the best matched-budget coverage across all six generation benchmarks, as well as higher experimental-form recovery, lower experimental-form ranks, and faster convergence in ranking.

</details>


### [294] [Adversarial Training Without Input Gradients via Low-Rank Householder Expansions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26963)
*Tiana C. Johnson,Donsub Rim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种无需输入梯度迭代的对抗训练方法。该方法通过低秩Householder展开（LRHE）直接从网络参数线性化计算出小平移范数（相对ℓ²范数）的对抗样本，并在训练中完全消除min-max公式的内层最大化步骤，仅需额外的前向计算即可实现对抗正则化，其计算成本仅为40步PGD对抗训练的1/8.7。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度神经网络对输入具有固有的不稳定性，会产生小范数对抗样本。现有对抗训练方法依赖输入梯度迭代（如PGD）来求解内层最大化问题，计算开销大。作者希望找到一种无需对输入求导、消除内层搜索的对抗训练正则化方法。

Method: 本文提出低秩Householder展开（LRHE）来线性化网络的复合仿射映射（而非单个层）。该方法从正向传播中已有的激活模式中直接读取对抗方向，无需输入梯度迭代。基于此构造对抗训练正则化方案：训练过程中不涉及对输入的微分，只需额外的前向计算，权重参数通过标准反向传播更新，彻底消除了传统min-max框架中的内层最大化。

Result: 该正则化方法在每个epoch的成本仅相当于2.8次PGD步骤，相比40步PGD对抗训练降低了8.7倍，甚至低于3步PGD训练的成本。在相对ℓ²范数预算ε≤0.02时与3步PGD对抗训练性能相当，在ε≤0.012时与40步PGD训练相当，超出此范围后性能下降，这与该展开的局部性一致。

Conclusion: 作者的核心发现是：现有所有免内层搜索的对抗训练方法都通过对输入求导来获取局部几何信息，而本文证明这一步骤并非必要。通过LRHE从网络参数直接构建对抗正则化器，可以在极低计算成本下实现与小步数PGD对抗训练相当的鲁棒性，其适用性受限于小范数（局部线性区域）范围。

Abstract: This work concerns adversarial training against the small-norm adversarial examples that arise from the inherent input instability of a trained deep neural network. Examples in this class are small as measured in the relative $\ell^2$-norm, and therefore lie in the neighborhood of the input on which the model acts approximately linearly, the regime in which the perturbation remains imperceptible. We first show that such examples can be computed directly from the trained network parameters, without input gradient iterations, by means of a linearization called the low-rank Householder expansion (LRHE). The expansion describes the composed affine map rather than any individual layer, and the directions it identifies are read from the activation pattern already available in the forward pass. We then propose a simple adversarial training scheme built on this construction. No differentiation with respect to the input is performed at any point: training requires only additional forward evaluations, with weight parameters updated by the standard backward pass, and the inner maximization of the usual min-max formulation is eliminated entirely. That such a regularizer exists is our main finding: the methods that dispense with the inner search all obtain their local geometry by differentiating with respect to the input, and we show this is not necessary. The regularizer costs the equivalent of $2.8$ PGD steps per epoch, an $8.7\times$ reduction relative to 40-step adversarial training on MNIST and below the cost of 3-step training. The resulting models match three-step PGD adversarial training for relative $\ell^2$ budgets $\varepsilon \le 0.02$ and 40-step training for $\varepsilon \le 0.012$, falling away beyond, consistent with the locality of the expansion.

</details>


### [295] [Graph-Based Pseudo-multimodal Contrastive Learning for 12-Lead ECG Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26964)
*Mengyu Wang,Kozo Okada,Takafumi Goto,Natsuko Jinba,Hiroki Yamaya,Kiyoshi Hibi,Tomoki Hamagami*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Graph-CMMC框架，将12导联心电图（ECG）波形转换为Gramian Angular Difference Field（GADF）图像，构建伪多模态对比学习框架，通过图神经网络建模导联间依赖关系，在多标签冠状动脉闭塞分类任务上取得了与监督学习方法相当的竞争性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有ECG分析方法多专注于单导联信号或独立处理每个导联，通常以一维时间序列数据配合CNN/RNN进行建模。这类方法虽然擅长建模局部波形变化，但难以捕捉临床诊断中至关重要的导联间依赖关系和全局波形模式。

Method: 提出Graph-CMMC框架：(1) 将12导联ECG波形转换为GADF图像，构建同一心脏活动的互补表示，形成伪多模态学习设定；(2) 在自监督方式下对齐波形与GADF表示；(3) 引入基于图的关联模块建模导联间依赖，并在对比学习过程中强制执行跨导联的结构一致性。

Result: 在多标签冠状动脉闭塞分类任务上，Graph-CMMC取得了与监督学习方法相当的竞争性能，验证了GADF作为互补表征的有效性以及显式图建模导联间依赖对学习鲁棒12导联ECG表示的作用。

Conclusion: 研究表明，将ECG信号通过GADF转化为图像表示作为互补模态，并结合显式的图结构建模导联间依赖，能够有效提升12导联ECG表示学习的鲁棒性，为ECG分析提供了新的技术路径。

Abstract: 12-lead electrocardiogram (ECG) is a standard, non-invasive examination widely used for diagnosing coronary artery disease, where clinical interpretation relies on comparing waveform patterns across multiple leads. However, most existing ECG analysis methods focus on single-lead signals or treat each lead independently, and typically process ECG signals as one-dimensional time-series data using CNNs or RNNs. While effective in modeling local waveform changes, such approaches have difficulty capturing inter-lead dependency and global waveform patterns essential for clinical diagnosis.
  To address this limitation, we propose a graph-based pseudo-multimodal contrastive learning framework called Graph-CMMC. ECG waveforms are transformed into Gramian Angular Difference Field (GADF) images to construct complementary representations of the same cardiac activity, enabling a pseudo-multimodal learning setting. Using all 12 leads, Graph-CMMC aligns waveform and GADF representations in a self-supervised manner, while a graph-based relational module is employed to model inter-lead dependency and enforce structural consistency across leads during contrastive learning.
  Experimental results on a multi-label coronary artery occlusion classification task demonstrate that the proposed framework achieves competitive performance compared to supervised learning methods. These results further suggest the effectiveness of using GADF as a complementary representation and incorporating explicit graph-based modeling of inter-lead dependency for learning robust 12-lead ECG representations.

</details>


### [296] [ClusterAttention: A training-free speedup of bidirectional attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26965)
*Kasper Nordenram,Amelie Dittmann*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ClusterAttention是一种无需训练的通用加速方法，通过快速递归聚类将键和查询分组为固定大小（2的幂）的簇，实现块稀疏注意力在GPU上与稠密注意力相同的交互延迟。该方法通过质心补偿被排除的簇来减少输出误差，并在大型表格数据（TabPFN-3）上实现2-6倍加速且保留至少99%的稠密精度，在视频生成（Wan 2.1-14B T2V）上相比SVOO取得更大加速（1.8倍vs 1.4倍）且输出更接近稠密注意力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有稀疏注意力方法要么依赖输入的结构性先验（如语言中的顺序或图像中的空间邻近性），要么使用缓慢的聚类过程并将开销分摊到多次前向传播中。这限制了训练后加速方法在非结构化输入和单次前向传播场景中的应用。作者旨在提出一种无需训练、不依赖输入结构、且聚类开销可忽略的通用双向注意力加速方法。

Method: ClusterAttention采用快速递归聚类方法，自适应每个注意力头中键和查询的几何分布来生成有用的簇。关键设计包括：（1）设置所有簇为固定大小且为2的幂，使块稀疏注意力在GPU上的每个查询-键交互延迟与稠密注意力相同；（2）推导稀疏注意力的输出误差表达式，解释了紧密簇反而比随机簇产生更大误差的反直觉实验现象；（3）推导通过簇质心补偿被排除簇时的误差，证明该误差随簇更紧密而减小，并将此补偿集成到方法中。

Result: 在大型表格数据上，ClusterAttention使TabPFN-3加速2至6倍，同时保留至少99%的稠密精度，是首个可在非结构化输入和单次前向传播场景下成功应用的免训练方法。在视频生成任务中，对Wan 2.1-14B T2V，ClusterAttention相比为该领域专门开发的主流方法SVOO，在无离线校准的情况下获得更大加速（1.8倍vs 1.4倍）且输出更接近稠密注意力。

Conclusion: ClusterAttention通过快速递归聚类和质心补偿策略，成功解决了免训练稀疏注意力在非结构化输入和单次前向传播场景中的适用性问题，在表格数据和视频生成两大领域均验证了其有效性和优越性，为通用双向注意力加速提供了新的思路。

Abstract: This paper introduces ClusterAttention, a general training-free speedup of bidirectional attention layers. Existing sparse attention methods either rely on structure in the input, such as order in language or spatial proximity in images, or use slow clustering processes amortized over several forward passes. ClusterAttention instead uses a fast recursive clustering method that adapts to the geometry of the keys and queries in each attention head to produce useful clusters. This method allows setting the size of the clusters arbitrarily. We utilize this by setting all clusters to be a fixed size that is a power of two, allowing the block-sparse attention to run at the same latency per query-key interaction as dense attention on GPUs. We also derive an expression for the output error in sparse attention, that explains the counterintuitive experimental finding that tight clusters can lead to larger errors than random clusters. We then derive the error when excluded clusters are compensated through their centroids, and show that this error shrinks with tighter clusters. We integrate this compensation into the method.
  On large-scale tabular data ClusterAttention speeds up TabPFN-3 arXiv:2605.13986 by two to six times, while retaining at least 99% of the dense accuracy. To our knowledge, it is the first training-free method that can be successfully applied in the setting of unstructured input and a single forward pass. For video generation with Wan 2.1-14B T2V arXiv:2503.20314 , ClusterAttention achieves output closer to dense attention and a larger speedup (1.8x versus 1.4x) compared to SVOO arXiv:2603.18636 , a leading method developed specifically for this domain, both run without offline calibration.

</details>


### [297] [TEMPLAR Wales: A georeferenced environmental and toponymic dataset of Welsh settlements](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26970)
*Oktay Karakuş,Can Eyupoglu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: TEMPLAR Wales是一个包含3,757条威尔士聚落记录的地理参考环境-地名数据集，通过稳定标识符将可复现的聚落框架、确定性词汇筛选和环境属性链接起来，以四个关系表形式发布，并经过严格技术验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 地名是描述和组织景观的持久记录，但其定量复用需要将映射的地点、词法标注和环境测量明确分离。现有资源往往将三者混为一体，缺乏可复现的框架，限制了地名学、语言学地理学和环境景观研究的定量分析。

Method: 构建TEMPLAR Wales数据集：包含3,757条威尔士聚落记录；采用冻结的24个威尔士地名元素注册表进行确定性词汇筛选（保留精确和前缀匹配及其来源）；从多个空间尺度提取环境属性（河流/海岸邻近度、海拔、地形上下文、土地覆盖和邻域木本覆盖），并从独立海拔产品中获取平行地形测量；以四个关系表分发，附带字段级数据字典、来源登记和许可元数据。

Result: 数据集包含1,294个聚落中的1,350个词汇检测；技术验证确认了关系完整性、确定性词汇重构、文档化环境覆盖、独立地形源之间的高度一致性以及冻结版本的可复现重建。

Conclusion: TEMPLAR Wales为地名学、语言地理学、历史与环境景观研究、GIS和空间数据分析提供了可复用的基础，同时明确区分了计算词汇检测（非已验证词源）与现代环境测量（非历史景观重建）的边界。

Abstract: Place names provide persistent records of how landscapes have been described and organised, but their quantitative reuse requires explicit separation between mapped places, lexical annotations and environmental measurements. TEMPLAR Wales is a georeferenced environmental-toponymy dataset comprising 3,757 settlement records across Wales. The resource links a reproducible settlement frame to deterministic lexical screening and settlement-level environmental attributes through stable identifiers. It contains 1,350 lexical detections across 1,294 settlements, generated from a frozen registry of 24 Welsh place-name elements, while retaining exact- and prefix-token matches and their provenance separately. Environmental attributes describe river and coastal proximity, elevation and local terrain context at multiple spatial scales, land cover and neighbourhood woody cover, with parallel terrain measurements derived from independent elevation products. The dataset is distributed as four relational tables accompanied by a field-level data dictionary, source-provenance register and licensing metadata. Technical validation confirms relational integrity, deterministic lexical reconstruction, documented environmental coverage, strong agreement between independent terrain sources and reproducible reconstruction of the frozen release. TEMPLAR Wales provides a reusable foundation for research in toponymy, linguistic geography, historical and environmental landscape studies, GIS and spatial data analysis without treating computational lexical detections as verified etymologies or contemporary environmental measurements as historical landscape reconstructions.

</details>


### [298] [Terrain signatures in Welsh settlement names](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26978)
*Oktay Karakuş,Can Eyupoglu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本研究使用冻结的24元素词法框架和预注册模型，分析3,757个威尔士定居点名称，发现高地形名称（bryn/mynydd）与低地形名称（cwm/pant）相比，其所在地比2公里周围环境平均高出24.4米，且该关联在多种邻域定义和独立高程源上均稳健，但无法推广到其他命名系统。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 地名是否保留了超越广泛地理结构的可测量环境信息，这一假设很少被严格检验。作者旨在用大规模、预注册、交叉验证的方法评估威尔士定居点名称与地形间的关联是否真实存在。

Method: 采用3,757个威尔士定居点数据，使用冻结的、经过来源审计的24元素词法框架；对预注册的特定结局模型进行拟合；采用地理结构化的验证（10/25/50公里空间分块）进行比较；核心对比是101个高地形名称（bryn/mynydd）与139个低地形名称（cwm/pant）的定居点；使用相对2公里邻域的高程差作为主要指标，并用独立高程源进行复现。

Result: 高地形名称定居点相对2公里周围环境高出24.4米（95%CI: 10.8-38.1米；Holm校正p=0.00137）；该关联在1、2、5公里邻域定义下均为正向，独立高程源复现为24.1米；地形名称极性加入基线模型后，在10、25、50公里空间分块下分别降低留出集均方误差4.63%、6.22%和7.30%。河流相关名称证据较弱但方向一致，林地模型不可估计。不同留出区域改进效果存在差异。

Conclusion: 选定的威尔士定居点名称类别确实保留了关于当今地形的可测量信息，但该发现不能证明个体词源、因果性的命名过程、历史环境记忆或对其他命名系统的可迁移性。残留空间结构、名称语言未解决及缺乏独立外部复现限制了结果的解释。

Abstract: Landscapes are named, but whether names retain measurable environmental information beyond broad geographic structure is rarely tested.
